_comment: Example configuration. Copy to config.json and fill in real values. Secrets (tokens, API keys) should live in .env instead; see .env.example.

cloud_image_gen._comment: Optional plugin — see docs/PLUGINS.md (audit B.6). Domain-flavored capability; safe to delete the whole block. The orchestrator does not require it. Replicate (FLUX) primary; Gemini fallback.
cloud_image_gen._api_key_note: Set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN in .env; leave api_key blank here.

mcp_servers._comment: Optional plugin — see docs/PLUGINS.md. Per-target MCP server configs (e.g. blender-mcp). Empty by default; the orchestrator does not require any to be present.

postgres._comment: Phase 2.1 durable system-of-record. Set enabled=true after install_postgres.sh + alembic upgrade head. Set POSTGRES_DSN in .env, not here.

redis._comment: Phase 2.2 ephemeral state store. Set enabled=true after install_redis.sh + REDIS_URL in .env. Format: redis://:<password>@<redis-lxc-ip>:6379/0

otel._comment: Phase 2.3 OpenTelemetry tracing. Set enabled=true after install_tempo.sh and point endpoint at the Tempo OTLP/gRPC port (4317). OTEL_ENDPOINT in .env overrides this.

budget._comment: Phase 2.4 budget tracking. rates_per_million_tokens is keyed by model name; the 'default' entry is the fallback. Local Ollama models default to 0.0 (electricity is below the measurement threshold). thresholds_pct fires notifications at each crossing; 100 also auto-pauses the campaign.

sky._comment: Phase 2.5 SkyPilot cloud-burst. Ships dormant. Set enabled=true after configuring at least one cloud provider (e.g. RUNPOD_API_KEY in .env, then `sky check`). idle_timeout_minutes auto-stops idle clusters; max_burst_cost_usd is the per-burst safety ceiling.

smartpause._comment: Phase 3.2 SmartPause. Auto-pauses a run when the planner self-reports confidence below threshold AND the campaign's hitl_mode is anything but full_auto. Threshold is in [0, 1]; 0.7 is the recommended starting point.

hitl._comment: Phase 3.1 HITL intervention modes. Per-campaign override via CampaignTemplate.hitl_mode (full_auto / gate_only / checkpoint / step_by_step / co_pilot). default_mode applies to runs not bound to a campaign. intervention_timeout_seconds bounds the orchestrator's wait at each pause; raise for unattended deployments.

note_discovery._comment: Phase 3.3 NoteDiscovery-grounded planner. Ships dormant. Flip enabled=true once the NoteDiscovery container at base_url is reachable; the orchestrator queries /api/search before each campaign and seeds params + evidence references from matching notes. Optional NOTEDISCOVERY_API_KEY in .env; auth is advertised in NoteDiscovery 0.19.1 OpenAPI but not enforced.

consumers._comment: Phase 3.6 external consumer registry + capability dispatch. The registry endpoints (/consumers, /capabilities/{cap}/invoke) are always available, bearer-auth gated. health_poll_seconds=0 keeps the consumer-health daemon dormant; set >0 to poll each registered consumer's /healthz. dispatch_timeout_seconds bounds an outbound capability-invoke proxy call.
